ai_executive_summary: CYBERWOLF AI identified 4 vulnerabilities on target (2 CRITICAL, 1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM). Priority remediation is urgently required for Log4Shell on port 8080 and SQL Injection on port 80.

findings.evidence: HTTP JNDI lookup header '${jndi:ldap://127.0.0.1/a}' triggered callback on port 8080.
findings.remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1+ or apply formatMsgNoLookups=true flag.

findings.evidence: Parameter 'search' produced MySQL syntax error when probed with "' OR '1'='1".
findings.remediation: Convert search query to prepared statements with parameterized inputs.

findings.evidence: Port 3306/tcp is publicly listening without network ACL restrictions.
findings.remediation: Bind MySQL to 127.0.0.1 or enforce firewall rules allowing only backend servers.

findings.evidence: HTTP 80 response lacks HSTS and Content-Security-Policy headers.
findings.remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security and Content-Security-Policy headers to Apache config.
